selection: All first16 scheduled sources plus explicit contrast cases selected after reading full403 news/native-topic union. Contrast cohort is purposive, not prevalence or performance evidence.

records.reference: whats happening in football today
records.rationale: Football today is explicitly queried as ongoing public/sports developments.

records.reference: tell me bbc news
records.rationale: BBC identifies the news source; no subject of the news is expressed.

records.reference: what is the current state of brexit negotiations
records.rationale: Current state of Brexit negotiations requests progress of an expressed public event.

records.reference: keep me updated on stock market prices
records.rationale: Stock market prices requests changing numeric quotations, not reports about market developments.

records.reference: read me the newest article on the new solar system
records.rationale: Newest article about a new solar system expresses a topical reported discovery in this context.

records.reference: let me know the latest weather news
records.rationale: Weather is explicitly the subject of news, not merely a requested measurement.

records.reference: what is the current price of brent crude
records.rationale: Current price of Brent crude asks for a numeric financial quote.

records.reference: what are some updates about the stock market
records.rationale: Updates about the stock market may mean quotes or news developments; no explicit distinction.

records.reference: alexa how many tornadoes have there been this month
records.rationale: How many tornadoes this month is a bounded count query without a reporting relation.

records.reference: set notification for news on the stock market
records.rationale: Stock market is explicitly the subject of requested news notifications.

records.reference: was there any articles on shark attacks on snapchat yesterday
records.rationale: Articles on shark attacks on Snapchat may be reporting or other articles; yesterday dates their presence and does not disambiguate report genre.

records.reference: iphone
records.rationale: Bare iPhone gives a subject fragment without a task/reporting relation.

records.reference: finance
records.rationale: Bare finance does not establish whether news, definitions or another service is requested.

records.reference: go to nytimes dot com
records.rationale: Opening a website supplies an access target, not a topic being reported about.

records.reference: olly hackernews
records.rationale: Hackernews alone does not settle access versus a request for news about the named service.

records.reference: please let me know when there is an update to the plane crash story
records.rationale: The plane crash story explicitly supplies a reported-event subject for updates.

records.reference: what's the latest on the train
records.rationale: Latest on the train could mean transport status or reporting about a train event.

records.reference: what is happening with president trump
records.rationale: What is going on with president Trump asks for public developments about the person, rather than a static attribute.

records.reference: i want topics on celebrity gossip
records.rationale: Celebrity gossip explicitly supplies a category of reporting subjects.

records.reference: cnn
records.rationale: Bare CNN does not determine access, source selection or news about the organization.

records.reference: get me the news about today's meeting
records.rationale: The meeting is explicitly the subject of requested news.

records.reference: what happened with it
records.rationale: What happened with it has no identifiable reporting context or established event reference.

records.reference: what is the economic policy of trump
records.rationale: Economic policy of Trump may ask a static policy description or public-policy developments; no temporal/reporting relation settles it.

records.reference: what's the latest on trump's travel ban
records.rationale: Latest on the travel ban is a request for developments in a specified public policy event.

records.reference: what happened yesterday from three pm to four pm
records.rationale: What happened yesterday in a time window could request personal calendar/history or public news; no subject/context settles it.

records.reference: how many people were at the protest in times square yesterday at noon
records.rationale: Attendance count at a protest is a specific numeric fact, not by itself a request for journalistic coverage.

records.reference: what is latest on the recent events happening right now
records.rationale: Recent events generically requests current coverage but supplies no topic beyond that general request.

records.reference: what is so clean news for the last six hours
records.rationale: Generic news over six hours supplies a time constraint but no expressed topic.

records.reference: olly do you have any local news
records.rationale: Local explicitly supplies a geographic scope for requested news, without identifying the location value.

records.reference: world news
records.rationale: World explicitly supplies the geographic scope of news.
